propositions: Jira rebar-id label is written before local CREATE event and binding are durably published, creating an ephemeral window where final push rejection on an ephemeral runner loses local state while the label persists.

Automated healing paths (binding_walk L10 guard, differ bug-4354 suppression, BindingRecovery.recover_pending_bindings) all stand down when the rebar-id label is present, leaving the drift permanently stuck.

The fix implements idempotent recovery in binding_walk phase-1b: replay the adopt when the rebar-id marker equals the deterministic inbound local id, no binding-store entry exists, and no local ticket exists.

The recovery extension reuses the existing _apply_inbound_create leaf and its idempotent guards (dedup_skipped on binding present, idempotent label write-back), ensuring the replayed adopt converges on the same local id and binding without creating duplicates.
Stand-down protections are preserved for foreign/ghost markers, multi-marker keys, keys with existing store entries, keys with existing local tickets, and retired keys.
bridge_fsck unbound_jira audit remains unchanged and continues alerting until the binding actually exists, providing end-to-end healing verification.
